p037.lead: Gabriel and the Evening Stars, the archangels, the High Commissioners, and the permanent citizens: a map of the personalities who run Nebadon together.

p037.foot.text: Dictated by a Brilliant Evening Star of Nebadon, Number 1,146 of the Created Corps

p037.s0.h: Introduction — The Local Universe as a Great Family
p037.s0.b0: Paper 37 gathers in one place the many personalities who work in our local universe of Nebadon. At their head stand the Creator Son, Michael, and the local universe Mother Spirit, the Divine Minister of Salvington. The two are co-ordinate in divinity and complemental in creative attributes, and the paper describes this relationship in the language of family, as “Father-Son” and “Spirit-Mother.”
p037.s0.b2: Earlier papers dealt with the created orders of sonship, and later ones will treat the ministering spirits and the ascending sons; this paper focuses on the group in between, the **Universe Aids**. It also adds brief notes on the higher spirits stationed in Nebadon and on the permanent citizens of the local universe. The names are many and unfamiliar, but if we follow what each group exists for, we can see how carefully a universe is run.
p037.s1.h: I. The Universe Aids — Seven Orders and Gabriel
p037.s1.b0: Many of the orders grouped as Universe Aids are unrevealed, but the paper presents seven. The first, the Bright and Morning Star, is one of a kind in each local universe, the first-born of all its native creatures. In Nebadon he is **Gabriel of Salvington**.

p037.s1.b2: Gabriel functions as the personal representative of the Sovereign Son and as spokesman for his creative consort. In Nebadon’s early days he worked almost alone with Michael and the Creative Spirit, but as the universe grew and its problems multiplied he was given a staff of unrevealed assistants, and in time the corps of Evening Stars was created to help him. When the work grows, co-workers are provided: this is the first picture we get of universe administration.
p037.s2.h: II. The Brilliant Evening Stars — Gabriel’s Hands and Feet
p037.s2.b0: The Evening Stars are superangels planned by the Melchizedeks and brought into being by the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit. Their chief work is as Gabriel’s liaison officers, representing him at the capital of every constellation and system. As many as a thousand conclaves may be in session on Salvington at once, and since Gabriel cannot attend them all, the Evening Stars represent him.
p037.s2.b2: What makes this order unique is that it is **twofold**. Some were created with this dignity from the start; others are ascendant spirits who reached it through service, many of them having begun as seraphim. When assigned to a mission, they always work in pairs, one created and one ascendant.

p037.s2.b5: On planetary missions Evening Stars have sometimes been known as “⟦Q 37:2.3⟧the angel of the Lord⟦/Q⟧,” and they accompany Avonal bestowal Sons as cocommanders of those undertakings. On the missions of Trinity Teacher Sons that open a postbestowal age, they serve as liaisons between mortals and the invisible corps of Teacher Sons. The sixth group of Salvington worlds and its forty-two satellites are under their administration, with joint schools for spirit personalities and for ascending mortals.
p037.s3.h: III. The Archangels — Servants of Survival and Resurrection
p037.s3.b0: Archangels are the offspring of the Creator Son and the Mother Spirit, the highest type of high spirit being produced in large numbers in a local universe; Nebadon has almost eight hundred thousand. They are normally outside Gabriel’s jurisdiction and take no part in routine administration, being dedicated wholly to creature survival and the ascending career of mortals.
p037.s3.b1: Remarkably, in recent times **a divisional headquarters of the archangels has been maintained on Urantia**. Student visitors from beyond Nebadon are surprised to find archangel activities directed from this small and seemingly insignificant world, and their interest quickens when they learn of Michael’s bestowal here. The author sees in this a sign that more ascendant activities will be concentrated on the bestowal world in the future.
p037.s3.b3: A corps of one hundred archangels goes with every Paradise bestowal Son to a planet, and two senior archangels serve as an Avonal’s personal aids. When a dispensation closes, it is literally true that the seraphic guardians of sleeping personalities respond to “⟦Q 37:3.6⟧the voice of the archangel⟦/Q⟧”; the one who proclaims the roll call is the archangel of the resurrection. On the seventh group of Salvington worlds, the personality record keepers keep each mortal’s record from birth onward and preserve personality records and identification sureties between death and repersonalization.
p037.s4.h: IV. Most High Assistants — Volunteers from Beyond
p037.s4.b0: The Most High Assistants are volunteers originating outside the local universe, temporarily assigned as representatives or observers of the central and superuniverses. Their number is always far up in the millions. Among them are Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, Universal Censors, Solitary Messengers, supernaphim, seconaphim, tertiaphim, and others, who help bring Nebadon into fuller harmony with the ideas of Orvonton and the ideals of Paradise.
p037.s4.b1: Technically they may stand outside local universe jurisdiction, yet when serving on request they often place themselves wholly under the directors of the realm. And there are times when certain advanced plans and complex rulings are wisely withheld for a while from the native personalities; these are better grasped by this more mature and farseeing corps. Here again we see higher beings setting aside their rights to serve a lower order.
p037.s5.h: V. High Commissioners — Speaking for Those Who Cannot
p037.s5.b0: High Commissioners are ascending mortals who are **Spirit fused**, not Adjuster fused. On certain worlds the Adjusters indwell mortals only transiently, guiding them through life in the flesh and fostering the soul, but taking eternal leave when life ends. The surviving soul then attains immortality by fusion with an individualized fragment of the spirit of the Mother Spirit. Most of these beings stop at Salvington and remain forever in local universe service.

p037.s5.b3: They are present in every tribunal from the lowest to the highest, and whenever justice requires an understanding of how a policy will affect the evolutionary races, they offer their recommendations. Not reaching Paradise may look like a loss, but in mastering Nebadon’s problems they gain an experiential wisdom far beyond that of transient ascenders, uniting the human and the divine viewpoints.
p037.s6.h: VI–VII. Celestial Overseers; Mansion World Teachers — One Vast School
p037.s6.b0: The Nebadon educational system is jointly administered by the Trinity Teacher Sons and the Melchizedeks, but much of its upkeep falls to more than three million Celestial Overseers. These volunteers, qualified by experience, have their headquarters on the Melchizedek worlds and travel the universe inspecting its school technique. The training runs from the worlds of human origin through the mansion worlds, the seventy realms of Edentia, and the 490 spheres of Salvington.
p037.s6.b2: The keynote of this whole educational system is **character acquired by enlightened experience**. The teachers provide enlightenment; one’s universe station provides the opportunity for experience. The student is given a definite task and at the same time learns how best to do it. Because work and instruction are always joined, this school is more like a workplace than a lecture hall.
p037.s6.b4: Progress is not spiritual development alone; intellectual acquisition grows alongside it. The ascender no longer has to referee the conflict between spiritual and material natures and enjoys instead the unified urge of a glorified mind. Most Urantia mortals will have the chance to serve as Celestial Overseers before leaving Nebadon. The Mansion World Teachers, for their part, are recruited and glorified cherubim, commissioned by the Melchizedeks, who carry much of the teaching of the morontia life.
p037.s7.h: VIII. Higher Spirit Orders of Assignment — The Hidden Workers of Administration
p037.s7.b0: Certain higher spirit beings of the Infinite Spirit’s family are permanently assigned to the local universe, and some of them are directly connected with Urantia. Andovontia, who oversees the spirit and morontia circuits, is the one who isolated Urantia after Caligastia’s betrayal during the Lucifer rebellion, and he expresses pleasure in anticipating our eventual restoration to the universe circuits.

p037.s7.b2: Each universe has its own angelic corps, but at times the help of higher spirits from outside is valuable. That the present chief of Urantia seraphim is a primary supernaphim of Paradise shows that care of a high order reaches even this isolated planet.
p037.s8.h: IX. Permanent Citizens of the Local Universe — Keepers of an Unchanging Place
p037.s8.b0: The local universe also has orders of permanent citizenship, beings who by and large neither ascend nor descend: the susatia, the univitatia, the Material Sons, and the midway creatures. Together with Spirit-fused ascenders and the spironga, they form a relatively permanent citizenry, and their growing experience remains available to the universe on their level of origin.

p037.s8.b2: The Material Sons and Daughters are a reproducing order, created when the creative union of the Son and the Mother Spirit has completed its cycle and the Son personalizes his last concept of being in dual form, male and female. Some are commissioned as Planetary Adams to found an Adamic race that will blend with the mortal inhabitants. The univitatia do for ascenders on the constellation spheres what the Havona natives do for pilgrims in the central universe.
p037.s8.b3: The account of the midway creatures is especially meaningful for readers on Urantia. Mortals are born, live, die, and move on to other worlds, and most celestial ministers are assigned only for a time. The midwayers, however, remain on the planet from the arrival of the Planetary Prince to the far-off age of light and life, providing continuity of planetary administration.
p037.s9.h: X. Other Local Universe Groups — Ascenders Who Reach Back
p037.s9.b0: Nebadon now has more than three million inhabited worlds, with ten million in prospect, and 647,591 architectural spheres. The paper singles out two orders among the many. The spironga, spirit offspring of the Bright and Morning Star and the Father Melchizedek, carry out routine spirit tasks, while the spornagia, neither spirits nor persons, care for the material side of the headquarters worlds.
p037.s9.b1: Ascending mortals who reach Salvington are also attached to universe service as helpers, students, observers, and teachers. This picture shows that ascension is not a solitary race to the top.
p037.s9.b3: The author says this is only a brief outline of the many personalities, and that the experience of the ascending career will gradually reveal them. The pilgrims of time advance from life to life and from world to world until they are lovingly dispatched onward to Paradise and the destiny of the finaliters.
p037.s10.b0: Paper 37 may look like a list of names, yet it holds one coherent picture. The local universe is a great family led by creator parents, and its orders are arranged to make up for one another’s limits, to speak for the weak, and to help those who come after. The purpose of all this administration is to raise the mortals of time into beings of character through experience.

p037.s10.b2: The next paper, Paper 38, turns fully to the ministering spirits mentioned briefly here, the angels of the local universe such as seraphim and cherubim. Keeping in mind the place of the Universe Aids sketched in this paper will make it easier to see the administrative setting in which the angels serve.
p038.lead: Seraphim, cherubim, sanobim, and the midway creatures: the ministering spirits of the local universe who bridge the material and spiritual worlds.

p038.foot.text: Presented by a Melchizedek acting by request of the Chief of the Seraphic Hosts of Nebadon

p038.s0.b0: Paper 38 introduces the angels of the local universe. The author begins by noting that the personalities of the Infinite Spirit fall into three distinct orders, and takes a New Testament verse as his clue. The apostle who wrote that angels and authorities and powers had been made subject to Jesus had already captured this division.

p038.s0.b2: As the supernaphim serve in the central universe and the seconaphim in a superuniverse, so the angelic corps of a local universe consists of **seraphim, cherubim, and sanobim**. Seraphim are almost uniform in design throughout all seven superuniverses, the most nearly standard of all personal spirit beings. They are the skilled and common ministers of the local creations.
p038.s1.h: I. Origin of Seraphim — The Mother Spirit’s First Solitary Creation
p038.s1.b0: Seraphim are created by the Universe Mother Spirit. After the Creator Son and the Mother Spirit have together created many Sons, the Son turns to creating the Material Sons, the first sex creatures, while the Mother Spirit undertakes her first solitary effort at spirit reproduction. So begins the seraphic host, projected in units of 41,472 at a time.
p038.s1.b1: The creation of seraphim coincides with the planning for the evolution of mortal will creatures. Before that, the seraphim serving in Nebadon were on loan from a neighboring universe. And their creation still goes on, because the universe is still in the making.
p038.s2.h: II. Angelic Natures — Fellow Servants Who Know and Love Us
p038.s2.b0: Angels have no material bodies, but they are definite and discrete beings. We cannot see them, yet they perceive us as we are in the flesh. They understand the mode of mortal life, share our nonsensuous emotions and sentiments, and greatly enjoy our music, art, and real humor. They are fully aware of our moral struggles and spiritual difficulties.
p038.s2.b2: Seraphim are affectionate and sympathetic but are not sex-emotion creatures. In many powers they far surpass us; we would regard one as a “mathematical prodigy,” knowing such things as the number of our hairs without effort. Yet in personal status they are not far removed from human beings, and once delivered from the flesh we become very much like them.
p038.s2.b3: The two most practical teachings of this section concern judgment and worship. Angels are above us in spiritual status, but they are not our judges or accusers. And angels are to be loved, not adored. As the seraphim Loyalatia told the seer, they are fellow servants who, like us, are enjoined to worship God.
p038.s3.h: III–IV. Unrevealed Angels; The Seraphic Worlds — A Home Shared in Pairs
p038.s3.b0: In this paper the word “angel” is limited to the seraphim and their associated offspring, who are so largely concerned with the plans of mortal survival. The local universe also has six other orders of unrevealed angels, but they are never called seraphim and are occupied with administrative affairs unrelated to man’s ascent.
p038.s3.b1: The ninth group of seven primary spheres in the Salvington circuit, each with six satellites, are the seraphic worlds. The seraphim exclusively occupy the first cluster, while the six unrevealed angelic orders occupy the others. The seraphic estates are marked by beauty and vastness, and a home there is the dwelling of two seraphim. Though not male and female, seraphim are negative and positive, and most assignments require two angels.
p038.s3.b3: Seraphim gather for reunions every millennium. One whose duties forbid absence alternates with her complement, so that every partner is present at least every other reunion. It is a wise way to keep both the work and the bonds of community.
p038.s4.h: V. Seraphic Training — From Observer to Ministering Spirit
p038.s4.b0: Seraphim are not sent straight into service. The first Nebadon seraphim were trained by a corps of one thousand seraphim from Avalon, and since then the seniors have taught those who came after. The Melchizedeks also take a large part in the education of all local universe angels.

p038.s4.b2: Once commissioned, seraphim may range all Nebadon and even Orvonton, always linking the beings of the spirit world with the mortals of the material realms. The process mirrors the principle of universe education: responsibility is given only after experience has been gained.

p038.s5.b0: After training, seraphim are organized in units built on twelve. The legions Jesus spoke of in Gethsemane, when he said the Father would give him “⟦Q 38:6.1⟧more than twelve legions of angels⟦/Q⟧,” are one of these organizational units.

p038.s5.b2: Above all these armies stands Gabriel, the “⟦Q 38:6.2⟧supreme commander of the armies of heaven⟦/Q⟧.” Seraphim serve under the supervision of the Infinite Spirit as personalized on Salvington, but since Michael’s bestowal on Urantia all local universe orders have become subject to the Master Son’s sovereignty. When Michael was born in the flesh, a broadcast went out to all Nebadon: “⟦Q 38:6.3⟧And let all the angels worship him.⟦/Q⟧”
p038.s6.h: VII. Cherubim and Sanobim — The Angels Closest to Us
p038.s6.b0: Cherubim and sanobim share the origin and essential endowments of the seraphim, but they are the lowest order of angels. For that very reason they are the nearest of kin to the more progressive human beings of the evolutionary worlds. They are wonderfully intelligent, marvelously efficient, touchingly affectionate, and almost human.
p038.s6.b1: The cherubim is the positively charged senior personality; the sanobim is the negatively charged complement. They are inherently associated and functionally united, so they usually serve in pairs. They are the routine spirit workers on the individual worlds, assisting the seraphim, but they never serve as attending angels to human beings; that is an exclusive seraphic privilege.
p038.s6.b2: Cherubim assigned to a planet begin by studying its usages and languages. All ministering spirits speak two languages, that of their local universe and that of their superuniverse, and they acquire more in the schools of the realms. Every fourth cherubim is a quasi-material “fourth creature,” doing borderland work on the morontia training worlds much as the midway creatures do on the evolutionary planets.
p038.s7.h: VIII. Evolution of Cherubim and Sanobim — Two Embraces
p038.s7.b0: Cherubim and sanobim, too, have open avenues of service that lead to higher status. Not all have the same potential, however; with regard to evolution they fall into three classes.

p038.s7.b2: Experienced cherubim attached to guardians of destiny are left behind when their seraphic seniors depart with their wards. They are embraced by the Mother Spirit and become Mansion World Teachers; after long service they are re-embraced in groups of seven thousand and emerge as full-fledged seraphim. From then on they may serve as guardians of destiny, with a path open all the way to Paradise and the Corps of the Finality. Being left behind proves to be not an end but the door to a new beginning.
p038.s8.h: IX. The Midway Creatures — A Bridge Between Matter and Spirit
p038.s8.b0: The midway creatures have a threefold classification. They belong properly with the ascending Sons of God, factually with the orders of permanent citizenship, and functionally with the ministering spirits, since they serve mortals together with the angels. They appear on most inhabited worlds and are always found on decimal planets such as Urantia.

p038.s8.b3: The two orders can establish perfect synchrony with each other, so together they can use the whole range of energy, from the gross physical power of the material worlds up to the higher spirit forces. The paper then says that the gap between matter and spirit is bridged without a break by a chain of beings, and that within a single person these levels are unified by the mysterious work of the Thought Adjuster.
p038.s8.b5: On a world like Urantia, where the Planetary Prince defected and the Material Son failed, the midwayers become wards of the System Sovereign and work under the acting planetary custodian. If faithful to their trust, they will one day be mustered into the ranks of the ascending Sons and begin the Paradise adventure together with the very earth brethren they have served so long.
p038.s9.b0: The angels of Paper 38 are not distant or fearsome beings. They are fellow servants who know us as we are and love us, who do not accuse us, and who refuse our worship. They are commissioned only after long training, they work in pairs, and even when left behind they find a new path of growth. And every gap between matter and spirit is bridged by beings such as these.

p039.s0.b0: Paper 38 surveyed the origin and nature of the seraphim; Paper 39 lays out, order by order, the work they actually do. The Mother Spirit intends to produce uniformly perfect seraphim, but for some unknown reason her offspring are very diverse. The author cautiously suggests this may be due to the interposition of experiential Deity, and he notes that once trained, seraphim fall distinctly into seven groups.

p039.s0.b2: It would hardly be true to call any order inferior to another. Each angel is at first limited to its original group, yet Manotia, the author’s seraphic associate, began as a supreme seraphim and by devoted service has achieved all seven services. Seraphim have no childhood, but they are experiential creatures who must gain knowledge and experience much as we do. So the more highly endowed an angel is, the more persistently it seeks assignment to the lower services.
p039.s1.h: I. Supreme Seraphim — Speaking for Mercy Within Justice
p039.s1.b0: The supreme seraphim are the highest of the seven revealed orders and function in seven groups. Among the Son-Spirit ministers are the 144 bestowal attendants, completion seraphim who have attained Paradise, who organize and direct all angelic activity on an Avonal’s bestowal mission.

p039.s1.b2: The account of the court advisers is especially striking. The universe tribunals exist not to hand down punishments but to adjudicate honest differences and decree survival. Justice requires that every default be adjudicated, but mercy requires that every misstep be fairly judged in light of the creature’s nature and the divine purpose. The seraphic advisers speak for that element of mercy.
p039.s1.b4: The universe orientators ease the feeling, something like nostalgia, of ascenders leaving their local universe. Just when they think they stand at the climax of the morontia ascent, these angels help them see that they are really at the very bottom of the long ladder of spiritual ascent. Here again appears a universe principle: the end of one stage is the beginning of the next.
p039.s2.h: II. Superior Seraphim — The Voice of Mercy and the Universe Transporters
p039.s2.b0: The superior seraphim are so named not because they are qualitatively superior but because they handle the higher activities of the local universe. They serve as Gabriel’s intelligence corps, gathering information from all the realms, and as recorders and broadcasters of Salvington’s records. Their second group, the **Voice of Mercy**, reveals the character of the whole order.
p039.s2.b2: The description of the transporters gives a preview of what ascenders will actually experience. Until they awaken on Paradise, ascenders depend on seraphic transport to travel from world to world. Enseraphimed, they sleep for a set time and awaken at the appointed moment, while the Adjuster remains fully conscious. Angels cannot carry bodies of flesh and blood, and they do not function in natural death.
p039.s3.h: III. Supervisor Seraphim — Tending Law, Society, and Ethics
p039.s3.b0: The supervisor seraphim have their headquarters on the constellation capitals. The **law forecasters** place before the lawmakers a forecast of how any proposed enactment would affect the lives of freewill creatures. They speak not for man’s passing wishes but for the true longings of the evolving morontia soul, and in this way even mortals contribute to the evolution of universe law.
p039.s3.b2: The **social architects** seek to strip associations of all artificiality and to bring people together on the basis of real self-understanding and mutual appreciation. Two beings form a partnership, but when three or more are grouped, it becomes a social problem and falls under their jurisdiction. They cannot always assemble the ideal group, so they use the best material available. The **ethical sensitizers** foster appreciation of the morality of interpersonal relationships and give their full guidance in the brotherhood schools of Edentia.
p039.s3.b3: The constellation transporters do not fly like inanimate projectiles; they are fully conscious of their velocity, direction, and position, and on long journeys they average more than 555,000 miles per second.
p039.s4.h: IV. Administrator Seraphim — Teachers of Loyalty and Sincerity
p039.s4.b0: The administrator seraphim assist with the affairs of the local systems; the present acting ruler of Urantia is aided by a thousand of them. The **justice guides** prepare the defense in cases of doubtful survival, seeing that justice is not defeated but dealt out with generous mercy. In the Lucifer rebellion very few justice guides were lost, but more than a quarter of the other administrator seraphim and lower seraphic orders were misled.
p039.s4.b1: The **interpreters of cosmic citizenship** guide ascenders who have finished the mansion worlds through their first breathing spell, when as citizens of Jerusem they taste the sweetness of goal fulfillment. The **quickeners of morality** teach the interplay of liberty and loyalty. Loyalty is the fruit of an intelligent appreciation of universe brotherhood, and there is an order to the personality scale.

head: Order of learning on the personality scale
Meaning
rows: 1. Loyalty
The fruit of an intelligent appreciation of universe brotherhood
2. Love
Learned after loyalty
3. Filiality
Learned after love
4. Liberty
Finality of liberty comes only with perfection of loyalty — not before one is a finaliter

p039.s4.b4: These seraphim teach that stagnation is certain death, but overrapid growth is equally suicidal. Progress is gradual, like water flowing through a succession of short falls. And our short life on Urantia is only the first link in a long chain, so the experience of living this life matters more than what we learn in it.
p039.s5.h: V. Planetary Helpers — Angels Who Plant Brotherhood, Peace, and Trust
p039.s5.b0: The planetary helpers serve the Planetary Adams, the biologic uplifters of the evolutionary races. On Urantia most were withdrawn when the Adamic regime collapsed, but those who remain are still at work. Their names point to virtues that evolutionary humanity does not naturally possess, qualities heaven itself must cultivate.

Mission and situation on Urantia
rows: Voices of the Garden
Personal seraphim of Adam and Eve in Eden — some assigned to Adam’s successors

Souls of Peace
Bringing “peace on earth” — their chief Vevona heralded it at Michael’s birth
Spirits of Trust
Instilling trust in suspicious primitive minds — a civilization embodying their ideals is evolving
Transporters · Recorders · Reserves
Interplanetary transport, records of major planetary affairs, messengers from Jerusem

p039.s5.b3: The passage on the spirits of trust turns our usual idea of faith around. Before man trusts God, the Gods trust man: the Father freely entrusts himself, as the Adjuster, to association with us. In more advanced ages these angels teach that uncertainty is the secret of contented continuity, and that the unknown future holds romance and charm.
p039.s5.b5: This section also explains where the idea of winged angels came from. People who glimpsed seraphim being prepared for transport saw what looked like double sets of wings from head to foot; these are in reality energy insulators, friction shields.
p039.s6.h: VI–VII. Transition Ministers; Seraphim of the Future
p039.s6.b0: The transition ministers serve wherever creatures pass from the material to the spiritual estate, and in Satania they now devote their greatest efforts to educating survivors on the seven mansion worlds. They have seven assignments, seraphic evangels, racial interpreters, mind planners, morontia counselors, technicians, recorder-teachers, and ministering reserves, which are described more fully in the papers on the mansion worlds. The seraphim of the future work mainly on advanced planets in preparation for the age of light and life; since they are not now directly concerned with Urantia, their description is withheld.
p039.s7.h: VIII–IX. Seraphic Destiny; The Corps of Seraphic Completion — On to Seraphington
p039.s7.b0: The eternal goal of all seraphim is **Seraphington**, the angelic destination of the grand universe. Some rise to high offices such as Brilliant Evening Stars in the local universe, but Seraphington always remains the angelic threshold from the ministry of time to the service of eternity.

head: Main routes by which seraphim reach Paradise
What they involve
rows: 1. Perfection of specialized service

2. Summons to Seraphington

3. The evolutionary mortal technique
Ascending with a mortal ward as guardian of destiny — the surest path

p039.s7.b2: Angels are created “a little higher than you,” so they cannot start from the very bottom. Instead it has been arranged that they go down to those who do start at the bottom and pilot them, step by step, to the portals of Havona. The guardians then bid their pilgrims a temporary farewell to achieve the seven circles of Seraphington, and many rejoin them on Paradise. No angel attaining Seraphington has ever gone astray.
p039.s7.b4: For angels who enter the Corps of Seraphic Completion, the career of time is finished. They become servants of God and peers of the finaliters, yet many return to their native universes to add experiential perfection to their divine endowment. What they most desire, still, is to serve the plan that sets evolutionary mortals on the journey to Paradise.
p039.s8.b0: Paper 39 is a list of angelic duties, but the names of those duties add up to an ethic. Mercy, brotherhood, peace, trust, loyalty, and sincerity are both the angels’ names and their work. They too long to start at the bottom, grow by experience, and determine their own destiny by guiding us. Service is the path of ascension: that is the central message of this paper.

p039.s8.b2: The next paper, Paper 40, turns from angels to humans and treats the ascending Sons of God, including the Adjuster-fused mortals. The guardians of destiny met in this paper are the very angels who accompany us on that path of ascent.
p040.lead: From evolutionary seraphim to Personalized Adjusters, and the mortals fused with Father, Son, or Spirit: the seven classes of ascending sonship and their destinies.

p040.foot.text: Presented by a Mighty Messenger temporarily attached to the staff of Gabriel of Salvington

p040.s0.h: Introduction — An Author Who Was Once a Mortal
p040.s0.b0: The Urantia Papers began with the Deities and have descended the scale of universe beings until reaching the lowest life endowed with the potential of immortality. Paper 40 marks a turning point in that course. Its author is a Mighty Messenger who was once a mortal on an evolutionary world, and he now sets out the purpose of the Gods concerning the **ascending Sons of God**.

head: Seven classes of ascending sons
Key point in this paper
rows: 1. Father-fused mortals
Fused with the Adjuster — pass through Havona and find God on Paradise
2. Son-fused mortals
Fused with the spirit of the Creator Son — usually remain in the superuniverse
3. Spirit-fused mortals
Fused with the spirit of the Mother Spirit — usually permanent citizens of the local universe
4. Evolutionary seraphim
Through guardian service to Seraphington and Paradise
5. Ascending Material Sons
Adams and Eves who finish their mission and begin the ascent
6. Translated midwayers
Released from planetary service in the age of light and life
7. Personalized Adjusters
Adjusters given personality by the Father — the highest order

p040.s1.b0: Before treating the three orders of mortals in detail, the paper briefly introduces the nonmortal ascending sons. What they share is this: even beings who descended or who served can enter the path of ascent through experience.

head: Being
How it becomes an ascending son
rows: Evolutionary seraphim
Through experience and service guarding the mortals of time — many mustered into the Corps of Mortal Finality
Ascending Material Sons
When their mission succeeds and the world is settled in light and life, they resign and register as perfected Material Sons
Translated midwayers
Released around the intermediate epochs of light and life — all secondary midwayers go to the Mortal Corps of Finality
Personalized Adjusters
Personalized by the Father after repeated service or unusual experience such as indwelling a bestowal Son

p040.s1.b2: For an angel, reaching finaliter sonship is said to be a far greater achievement than mortal survival with the help of an indwelling Adjuster. Personalized Adjusters, for their part, are classed as ascending sons because they have become experiential by sharing in mortal lives. The paper also makes clear that when a mortal fails to survive, it is never due to any neglect on the part of the Adjuster.
p040.s2.h: V. Mortals of Time and Space — The Farthest Comes Nearest
p040.s2.b0: Mortals are the last link in the chain of beings called sons of God. The touch of the Eternal Son reaches down through ever less divine and more human personalizations to a being we can see and touch, and the line of the Infinite Spirit reaches its limit in the angels. The Father cannot step himself down in that way, yet as the Adjuster within us he comes nearest of all.
p040.s2.b2: Mortals are therefore classified chiefly by their relation to the Adjuster, since the Adjuster is the only spirit with potential for fusion during life in the flesh.

head: Mortal series
Relation to the Adjuster
Path of survival
rows: Series one
In primitive times the Adjuster sojourns transiently and experientially — group custodians instead of personal guardians
Eternal life through the embrace of the Mother Spirit — many pre-Adamic Urantians
Series two
Modified types that do not fuse with Adjusters (many nonbreathers, among others)
On survival the soul becomes Spirit fused
Series three
Adjuster-fusion potential — one-, two-, and three-brained types; Urantians are two-brained
Fusion with the Adjuster and on to Paradise

p040.s2.b5: The author frankly says he does not know why the second series cannot fuse with Adjusters. But on the chances of survival he is emphatic: what decides survival is not the type of brain or the conditions of a planet, but the desire to find God and the willingness to co-operate with the Adjuster.
p040.s3.h: VI. The Faith Sons of God — Five Reasons We Are Sons
p040.s3.b0: Mortals are the lowest order of intelligent creation and are not yet divine by nature. They are reckoned ascending sons the instant fusion occurs, but until then they hold the status of **faith sons**. The paper insists that this is no small status but a solemn and supernal fact, and it gives five grounds on which Urantia mortals may regard themselves as sons of God.

head: Ground of sonship
What it means
rows: 1. Promise and faith
By accepting sonship and believing in its reality, our sonship becomes eternally real
2. Michael our elder brother
A Creator Son became one of us and is our elder brother in fact
3. The spirit of a Son
A spirit freely poured out on all races draws us to the Son and the Father
4. Creature personality
The divine spontaneity of freewill action given by the Father
5. The indwelling fragment
A fragment of the Father lives within us, relating us directly to him

p040.s3.b2: This list shows that sonship is a gift, not something earned, and yet it becomes real by being received. Only the first ground is our response; the other four are things God has already done.
p040.s4.h: VII. Father-Fused Mortals — When Two Become One
p040.s4.b0: The indwelling of Adjusters is one of the unfathomable mysteries of God the Father. We are hardly yet ascending sons, but we may reach that status by faith and by freewill co-operation with the Adjuster. When we and our Adjusters are finally fused and made one, as in Christ Michael the Son of God and the Son of Man are one, we have in fact become ascending sons of God.
p040.s4.b2: Adjuster-fused mortals are the only class of human beings who all traverse the Havona circuits and find God on Paradise. Because the Father has bestowed himself upon us, he also gives the command, “⟦Q 40:7.4⟧Be you perfect⟦/Q⟧.” The author asks those of us who trudge through the so-called “⟦Q 40:7.5⟧vale of tears⟦/Q⟧” whether we grasp the grandeur of the destiny that lies before us.
p040.s5.h: VIII–IX. Son-Fused and Spirit-Fused Mortals — Different Paths, the Same Love
p040.s5.b0: Almost all survivors fuse with their Adjusters on the mansion worlds or soon after, but a few never do. They were judged worthy of survival and their Adjusters concurred, yet some synchronizing difficulty kept them from becoming one. When a court of inquiry finds the mortal not at fault, the Adjuster returns to Divinington and the mortal is fused with an individualized gift of the Creator Son’s spirit. There are fewer than a million such beings in Orvonton.
p040.s5.b2: Spirit-fused mortals are indwelt by Adjusters during life in the flesh but are not fusion candidates; at death the Adjuster departs, and on the mansion worlds they fuse with an individualization of the Mother Spirit’s spirit. Because the transcript of human memory belongs to the Adjuster, they awaken without consciousness of their former existence. Yet when seraphim retell their story and they consult the records, a residual experiential-recognition-response in the soul knows it to be true.
p040.s5.b3: This passage also offers an intriguing insight into memory and personality. Only experiences of spiritual value survive with the Adjuster, and ascenders from the same planet can pool their memories to reconstruct a shared past. And at a level deeper than memory, personality recognizes personality.
p040.s6.h: X. Ascendant Destinies — Different Does Not Mean Lesser
p040.s6.b0: A fused spirit always ascends to its level of origin, so each of the three fusion types has its own range of destiny.

head: Type of fusion
Fused spirit
Usual range of destiny
rows: Spirit fusion
An individualization of the spirit of the Divine Minister
The local universe — home on the eighth group of Salvington worlds
Son fusion
An individualization of the spirit of the Creator Son
The superuniverse — residence on Uversa
Father fusion
The Thought Adjuster
Through the universe of universes to Paradise and the Corps of the Finality

p040.s6.b3: This difference may look like a flaw in the ascension plan, but the author does not see it so. If every mortal left for Paradise, the local universes and superuniverses would depend wholly on beings in transit. Ascendant citizens who stay share in a universe’s long struggle to the end and gain a wisdom of focalized experience that finaliters do not acquire. And some Son-fused and Spirit-fused mortals, after transformation, actually do reach Paradise.
p040.s6.b5: The author looks farther ahead as well. When finaliters are pioneering the frontiers of divinity in outer space, Spirit- and Son-fused mortals may be maintaining the experiential balance of the perfected superuniverses and preparing to welcome the new pilgrims who will stream in from the galaxies of outer space. He also notes that Father-fused finaliters are, in the present universe age, still unfinished creatures, sixth-stage spirits, while those embraced by the Trinity are for now finished creatures. Destinies cannot simply be ranked high and low.
p040.s6.b6: In the end, the words “greater” and “lesser” hardly fit when comparing ascendant destinies. Every son shares the fatherhood of God, and the Father loves each one individually and personally. That love utterly eclipses all other facts.
p040.s7.b0: Paper 40 traces the many branches of sonship and arrives at a single conclusion. Sonship is a gift God gives first, and it becomes real when we receive it in faith and co-operate with the Adjuster. The paths differ, but the Father’s love makes no distinctions. What remains for us is to sense the obligation to make use of the plan already so freely provided.

head: Practice
The teaching behind it
rows: Treasure even a faint spark of faith
Survival is assured even if desire is but the first faint flicker
Accept yourself as a son or daughter of God
Sonship becomes eternally real when accepted and believed
Co-operate with the Adjuster in each day’s decisions
Ascending sonship is reached by faith and freewill co-operation
Do not rank others’ paths against your own
Destinies differ; none is greater or lesser
Give your heart to experiences of spiritual value
Only experiences of spiritual value are remembered with the Adjuster

p040.s7.b2: The next paper, Paper 41, turns back to the physical universe, treating the power centers and physical controllers of Nebadon and the nature of suns and stars. It examines the physical order on which the stage of the ascending sons is built.
p041.lead: Power centers and physical controllers, the density and radiation of suns, the escape of calcium, and the birth of Urantia: the paper that surveys the physical stage of Nebadon.

p041.foot.text: Presented by an Archangel in collaboration with the Chief of Nebadon Power Centers

p041.s0.h: Introduction — As Far as the Mother Spirit Reaches
p041.s0.b0: The papers before this one introduced the personalities of the local universe; Paper 41 turns to the **physical stage** on which those personalities live and work. Strikingly, it defines the boundary of a local universe not by astronomy but by a spiritual presence. What sets Nebadon apart from every other local universe is the space presence of the Divine Minister of Salvington, the Creative Spirit.
p041.s0.b2: The superuniverses are clearly separated in space, but no such sharp lines of physical demarcation set off the local universes. The reason is that local universes are organized on administrative principles, while their suns and planets take origin chiefly from nebulae. Nebadon itself was assembled from the progeny of Andronover and other nebulae; the power directors adjusted their motions until they traveled together as one unit, and today this local star cloud swings in an increasingly settled orbit about the Sagittarius center.
p041.s1.h: I. The Nebadon Power Centers — A Living System of Energy
p041.s1.b0: Nebulae are initiated by Paradise force organizers, but once they respond to gravity, the power centers and physical controllers take over and direct the physical evolution of the stars and planets that follow. This supervision was co-ordinated with the Creator Son’s plan as soon as he arrived, and a vast complex of communication lines, energy circuits, and power lanes came to bind the bodies of Nebadon into one integrated administrative unit.

head: Power center
Assignment
Location and role
rows: Supreme Power Centers of the fourth order
One hundred for the local universe
At the exact energy center of Salvington — they receive the power lines from Uversa and relay them down-stepped and modified
Supreme Power Centers of the fifth order
Ten for each constellation
In Norlatiadek, at the center of the enormous stellar system that forms the constellation’s physical core
Supreme Power Center of the sixth order
One for each system
In Satania, on a dark island at the astronomic center of the system — directing power to the Master Physical Controllers on the planets

p041.s1.b2: Together these power centers form a living system of control and equalization that keeps otherwise fluctuating energies in balance. They are not concerned, however, with transient and local upheavals such as sun spots. Architectural spheres like Salvington, Edentia, and Jerusem are lighted, heated, and energized by this system, quite independent of the suns of space.
p041.s2.h: II. The Satania Physical Controllers — Intelligence That Handles Energy
p041.s2.b0: Satania is one of the one hundred systems of the constellation of Norlatiadek and is made up of over seven thousand astronomical groups. Its energies are supervised by a Master Physical Controller headquartered on Jerusem and by five hundred thousand living and intelligent energy manipulators scattered throughout the system. Together they can mobilize, transform, and transmit nearly all of the physical energies of organized space.
p041.s2.b1: The paper explains this work by comparing it with the life we know. Plants turn the energy of light into vegetable growth, and animals turn that energy into activity; life itself has the power to change energy from one form into another. The physical controllers are related to the preliving manifestations of material energy much as the adjutant mind-spirits are concerned with the prespiritual functions of material mind.
p041.s2.b3: Urantia is a small planet lying in the lines of tremendous energies, in the circuit of enormous masses. Not every energy disturbance here is the controllers’ responsibility, and they themselves have trouble insulating against the powerful Norlatiadek currents. The order of the universe, it turns out, is maintained less like a perfect machine than by the unceasing labor of living beings.
p041.s3.h: III–IV. Our Starry Associates; Sun Density
p041.s3.b0: Upward of two thousand suns shine in Satania, and our own sun is an average blazing orb. The material makeup of all suns, planets, and even meteors is quite identical. Antares is four hundred and fifty times the diameter of our sun, yet space has abundant room for such giants. Suns that are too large soon break up or form double stars, and the light that reached Urantia in A.D. 1572 came from the most recent major double star explosion in Orvonton.

head: Color of a sun
What it indicates
rows: Reddish glow
A very young or a very old sun
Yellow tinge
Moderate youth or approaching old age
Brilliant white light
Robust and extended adult life
Intense white light in a dwarf
A collisional dwarf, possibly very young, that never knew an initial red stage

p041.s3.b2: What the paper says about solar density overturns common sense. Our sun is gaseous, yet it has about one and one-half times the density of water. Gaseous, liquid, and solid states are matters of atomic-molecular relationship, whereas density is a relationship of space and mass. So suns that are equally gaseous can differ enormously in density.

head: Example
Density and features
rows: Our sun
About one and one-half times the density of water — halfway between the densest and the most diffuse stars
A near-by senile sun
Forty thousand times as dense as our sun, about one ton per cubic inch — a faint reddish glow
Another near neighbor
Exactly the density of our atmosphere at sea level
Veluntia
One one-thousandth the density of Urantia’s atmosphere — one of the largest suns in Orvonton
Another Orvonton giant
Over three hundred million miles in diameter, forty million times our sun’s size, yet only about thirty times its mass

p041.s4.h: V–VI. Solar Radiation; Calcium — The Wanderer of Space
p041.s4.b0: The steady stream of escaping light proves that suns are not very dense. Fifteen feet of surface with the density of Urantia would trap all the X rays and light within. The interior of a sun is a vast X-ray generator, and an electron starting at its very center needs more than half a million years to work its way to the surface. The author underlines how real sunlight is by pricing it in the energy values of our own world.
p041.s4.b2: Energy in its flight through space moves straight forward. Light seems to travel in waves only because other forces act on it at the same time, just as rain falling straight down in a heavy wind looks like sheets and waves of water. To understand the behavior of light fully, the paper adds, we would need to grasp the activities of the Conjoint Actor and the Unqualified Absolute as well.
p041.s4.b3: Space is not empty. Atoms shattered in the solar elemental battles drift through it, especially sodium and calcium. Calcium is the chief element permeating the space of Orvonton, and it keeps its identity even after ionization and the battering of X rays. By juggling its nineteenth electron between two orbits more than twenty-five thousand times a second, a calcium atom grasps and lets go of the sunbeam and so rides it out of the sun.
p041.s4.b6: The section also warns that spectral analysis shows only the composition of a sun’s surface. Solar spectra show many iron lines not because iron is the sun’s chief element, but because the present surface temperature favors the registry of the iron spectrum. It is a lesson in scientific humility: do not judge the whole by what happens to be visible.
p041.s5.h: VII. Sources of Solar Energy — Seven Supplies
p041.s5.b0: The internal temperature of the suns is much higher than is commonly believed. Our sun’s surface is almost 6,000 degrees, but its central regions reach about 35,000,000 degrees Fahrenheit, where practically no whole atoms exist. The paper accounts for this enormous energy expenditure by naming seven sources in the order of their importance.

head: Order
Source of solar energy
rows: Annihilation of atoms and, eventually, of electrons
Transmutation of elements, including the radioactive energies thus liberated
Accumulation and transmission of certain universal space-energies
Space matter and meteors incessantly diving into the suns
Solar cooling and contraction
Gravity action at high temperatures, turning circuitized power into radiative energy
Light and matter recaptured after leaving the sun, with energies of extrasolar origin

p041.s5.b3: Whether a sun shines forever depends on where it stands. A sun in the main streams of universe energy can replenish its losses and blaze on indefinitely, while stars far from those channels gradually cool off and burn out. Yet even dying suns can be revived by collision or recharging, and those that finally explode become a rare form of energy that feeds other, better-placed suns.
p041.s6.h: VIII–IX. Solar-Energy Reactions; Sun Stability — The Balance of Gravity and Heat
p041.s6.b0: Suns connected to the energy channels release energy through various nuclear-reaction chains, the most common being the hydrogen-carbon-helium reaction, in which carbon acts as a catalyst. When hydrogen is exhausted, luminosity peaks; afterward gravity contraction sustains the light until the star becomes a white dwarf. Large suns may collapse suddenly through the escape of “runaway particles,” and the Crab nebula is an irregular nebula that arose in this way about nine hundred years ago.

head: Our sun’s life
What the paper says
rows: Youth
Mighty pulsations every three and one-half days
Now
Passing out of its six billionth year — the period of greatest economy; the pulsations survive as the eleven and one-half year sunspot cycle
Ahead
Shining at present efficiency for more than twenty-five billion years
Afterward
A partially efficient decline as long as its youth and stable period combined

p041.s6.b3: Ultimatons are not subject to local gravity, yet they are fully obedient to absolute or Paradise gravity and swing true to the circuit of the great ellipse of creation. That even the smallest unit of energy is tied to the center of all things echoes the picture of the gravity circuits drawn in Paper 12.
p041.s7.h: X. Origin of Inhabited Worlds — The Least Becomes Greatest
p041.s7.b0: Our solar system was born when the sun, then in a state of mighty pulsation, erupted matter as the massive Angona system swung near. Most solar systems had a quite different origin, but whatever the technique, gravity always produces the same pattern: a central sun with planets, satellites, and meteors. A world’s features are shaped by its mode of origin, its situation, its environment, its age and size; and even a planet of dual origin like Urantia passed through an early phase of volcanoes, earthquakes, and floods.
p041.s7.b1: The paper ends by giving our cosmic address. Urantia lies on the outskirts of Satania, Satania is next to the outermost system of Norlatiadek, and Norlatiadek is now traversing the outer fringe of Nebadon. Until Michael’s bestowal we were truly among the least of all creation.
p041.s8.b0: Paper 41 reads like a lecture in astronomy, yet beneath it lies a consistent vision of faith. The bounds of the universe are set by the presence of the Mother Spirit; the flow of energy is tended by living intelligences; the stability of a sun comes from a balance between gravity and heat. And a small planet on the edge of things became, through Michael’s bestowal, a place of great universe interest. To know the material world is bound up with knowing the order of the One who made it.

The teaching behind it
rows: Do not take sunlight for granted; give thanks for it
Light is real and of immense value
Do not judge people or events by the visible surface alone
Spectra show only the composition of a sun’s surface
Stay close to the great currents of life and be replenished
Only suns in the main energy streams shine forever
Seek balance amid tension and pressure
A sun’s stability depends on the balance of gravity and heat
Do not lose heart for being small or on the margins
The least becomes greatest

p041.s8.b2: Paper 42 carries the physical account of this paper further, treating energy, matter, and the systems of mind. If we keep in mind the power centers and suns described here, it will be easier to follow how energy becomes organized into matter.
p042.lead: From energy going forth from Paradise, through force, matter, and mind, to its overcontrol by spirit: the paper that reads the structure of the physical universe through the eyes of mind and spirit.

p042.foot.text: Presented by a Mighty Messenger on duty in Nebadon and by the request of Gabriel

p042.s0.b0: Paper 42 is the most “physical” paper in The Urantia Book. It covers the levels of force and energy, the classification of matter, wave phenomena, ultimatons, electrons, and atoms, and even the cohesion of the atomic nucleus. Yet the author’s starting point is not the laboratory but God. The universe is material in the sense that energy is the basis of all existence, but that pure energy is controlled by the Universal Father.
p042.s0.b2: The manipulation of energy follows the personal will of the Father, though it is modified by the acts of the Eternal Son, the Conjoint Actor, and a vast number of subordinates. None of this lessens the truth that all force-energy is under the ultimate control of a personal God resident at the center of all things. That sentence is the key to the whole paper: even a physical world that looks impersonal is bound to a personal source.
p042.s1.h: I. Paradise Forces and Energies — A Stream That Returns to Its Source
p042.s1.b1: Matter and energy are diverse manifestations of the same cosmic reality, and the lines of gravity in all matter derive from Paradise. However far science advances, even to controlling the electrical units of matter, scientists will forever be powerless to create one atom, to originate one flash of energy, or to add life to matter. The creation of energy and the bestowal of life belong to the Universal Father and his associate Creator personalities.
p042.s1.b2: Force-energy is imperishable; it can be transformed without end but never extinguished. Yet it is eternal, not infinite, and whatever goes out from Paradise must return there, even if age upon age is required to complete the circuit. The author takes the absence of any evidence of energy depletion as confirmation of a circular and orderly universe.
p042.s2.h: II. Universal Nonspiritual Energy Systems (Physical Energies) — From Space Potency to Monota
p042.s2.b0: The author first admits the limits of language. In this paper “energy” denotes all phases of phenomenal motion and potential, while “force” is used for the pregravity and “power” for the postgravity stages of energy. On that basis he proposes a classification of physical energy to lessen conceptual confusion.

p042.s3.b0: Matter in all universes except the central universe is identical. Its properties depend on the revolutionary rates of its component members, their number and size, their distance from the nucleus, and certain forces not yet discovered on Urantia. In suns, planets, and space bodies there are ten grand divisions of matter.

p042.s4.h: IV–V. Energy and Matter Transmutations; Wave-Energy Manifestations
p042.s4.b0: Light, heat, electricity, magnetism, chemism, energy, and matter are one in origin, nature, and destiny. The same energy may appear as light in one universe, as heat in another, and ages later as electricity or matter. Next to gravity, temperature governs these changes: heat breaks atoms apart, while cold organizes ultimatons into electrons. And because energy is absorbed or released only in exact amounts called quanta, the integrity of matter is preserved.
p042.s4.b2: Orvonton has one hundred octaves of wave energy, sixty-four of which are recognized on Urantia. The author sorts them into ten groups, from infraultimatonic rays to Hertzian waves, yet the human eye responds to just one octave, the light of ordinary sunlight. The world we see is a very narrow band of the world that is, and that fact teaches humility.
p042.s4.b3: The so-called ether is merely a collective name for force and energy activities in space; it does not exist. Yet space is never empty. Even the most nearly empty space in Nebadon holds about one hundred ultimatons in each cubic inch, and the space within an atom is not empty either.
p042.s5.h: VI–VIII. Ultimatons, Electrons, and Atoms — A Little Universe Like the Solar System
p042.s5.b0: A typical electron consists of exactly one hundred ultimatons. Ultimatons respond only to circular Paradise gravity; linear gravity becomes fully operative with the appearance of atomic organization. The formation of all matter follows the pattern of the solar system, with electrons revolving like planets about the central proton. Local universes are of decimal construction, so there are just one hundred atomic materializations, and when one hundred and one electrons have been introduced, the center has instantly broken apart.

p042.s5.b2: Neither electric nor gravitational force holds the atomic nucleus together. The mesotron, 180 times as heavy as the electron, keeps the nucleus intact by tossing the electric charge back and forth between protons and neutrons. Even so, the force that binds proton to proton and neutron to neutron remains an energy not yet discovered. And from the twenty-eighth atom upward, the unpredictability of the presence of the Unqualified Absolute grows.
p042.s5.b4: Statistics can state laws for large numbers of atoms or persons, but never for a single atom or a single person. This insight, that room for individuality exists even in the depths of the physical world, warns us against reducing people to numbers.
p042.s6.h: IX. Natural Philosophy — Traces of Seven and Ten
p042.s6.b0: Natural philosophy tends to dogmatize as much as religion does. The number ten, the decimal system, is inherent in energy and matter, but the number seven is basic to the central universe and the spiritual system. When the elements are arranged by atomic weight, their properties recur in groups of seven, and the author calls this a birthmark carried by the material world, pointing to its far-distant spiritual origin.
p042.s6.b2: The philosophy of the universe cannot be built on observation alone. Nature is at once stable and biologically elastic only because of the well-nigh infinite wisdom of the Master Architects. Science and faith alike need the attitude that does not conclude something is absent simply because it cannot be seen.
p042.s7.h: X–XI. Material Mind Systems; Universe Mechanisms — Mind Within the Machine
p042.s7.b0: The latter part of the paper turns from energy to mind. The nonspiritual energies are reassociated on various levels in the living systems of non-Creator minds, and energy-matter is progressively brought under the overcontrol of spirit through the striving of living and personal mind.

p042.s7.b2: The universe is neither mechanical nor magical; it is a creation of mind and a mechanism of law. But the mind that governs it is spirit-mind functioning on creator levels, so finite scientific methods can hardly discern even a trace of it. The principle is that the higher the mind behind a phenomenon, the harder it is for lower minds to discover it.
p042.s7.b4: Spirituality in time and space is measured inversely to the linear-gravity response. The human material mind responds to gravity’s interactions, losing that response only in proportion to spirit identification. The very fact that mechanisms are not fixed but evolve points to the dominance of a purposive mind.
p042.s8.h: XII. Pattern and Form — Mind Dominance: The Spirit Has a Body
p042.s8.b0: The human ability to design machines shows the superiority of creative mind. Mind reaches out from the creation of material mechanisms through the discovery of mysteries, the formulation of mental systems, and the attainment of wisdom and spirit levels, to the accomplishment of divine destinies—supreme, ultimate, and absolute. Mind is also always creative, producing a body suited to each creature’s identity.
p042.s8.b1: Most spirit beings, too, have real forms, and morontia forms differ from one another just as human bodies do. There are exceptions, such as Thought Adjusters, which appear formless until they fuse with the soul. The most striking moment of the section is a reversal of perspective. We think of a body as having a spirit; the author regards the spirit as having a body.
p042.s9.b0: Paper 42 descends from ultimatons to atoms and then climbs back up to mind and spirit. Energy comes from Paradise and returns to Paradise; matter is dominated by mind, and mind by the overcontrol of spirit. For mortals, the hope of survival lies in a mind that freely follows the spirit’s direction. Studying the physical world, then, becomes a way of finding our own place within this order.

p043.s0.b2: Edentia is about one hundred times as large as Urantia. Seventy major spheres circle it, and ten satellites revolve around each of these, making 771 architectural spheres in all. Because the constellation is the midpoint of the morontia-training regime, its morontia life is both typical and ideal.
p043.s1.h: I. The Constellation Headquarters — A World Without Storms or Winter
p043.s1.b0: Edentia has fascinating highlands, tens of thousands of lakes, and countless interconnecting streams, but no rugged mountain ranges and no great oceans. Its atmosphere is a three-gas mixture—the two elements of Urantia’s air plus a morontia gas—and since there are no storms and no seasons, all outdoors can be embellished. Near the administrative center lies the sea of glass, a crystal about one hundred miles in circumference that serves as the receiving field.
p043.s1.b1: On the summit of the seventh highland range stand the resurrection halls, where mortals of the secondary modified order of ascension awaken. The Melchizedeks conduct an emergency school that studies the problems of the Satania rebellion and a bestowal school that deals with the problems arising from Michael’s final bestowal. The bestowal school was founded almost forty thousand years ago, immediately after Michael announced that Urantia had been chosen as his bestowal world.

p043.s2.b0: Each constellation is an autonomous unit, administered according to its own legislative enactments. Judicial problems are first reviewed by a council of twelve Melchizedeks, who formulate provisional verdicts and pass them on to the court of the Most High. The mortal division of that court consists of seven judges, all ascendant mortals.

p043.s3.h: III. The Most Highs of Norlatiadek — Rulers in the Kingdoms of Men
p043.s3.b0: The constellation rulers are Sons of the Vorondadek order, called **Most Highs** because they embody the highest administrative wisdom and the most intelligent loyalty. No disaffection of a Vorondadek Son has ever occurred in Nebadon. Gabriel commissions at least three for each constellation, and a Constellation Father reigns for ten thousand standard years, about 50,000 Urantia years.
p043.s3.b1: The old records of Urantia used the term “Most High” often, yet confused who was meant. Tribal deities were mixed in, and the Hebrews merged the various celestial rulers into a composite Deity. But Daniel, the author says, fully understood these matters.
p043.s3.b3: The Constellation Fathers are little occupied with individuals but are closely concerned with the lawmaking that affects races and nations. At the time of the Lucifer secession they seized certain phases of planetary authority on the rebellious worlds, and during Michael’s bestowal they directly supervised all Urantia affairs connected with it. Urantia therefore stands in a peculiarly close relation to the constellation rulers.
p043.s4.h: IV. Mount Assembly — The Faithful of Days
p043.s4.b0: The most holy mount of assembly is the dwelling of the Faithful of Days, the representative of the Paradise Trinity. He always stands at the right hand of the Constellation Fathers, yet never offers advice unless it is asked for. His residence is modest compared with the homes of the Most Highs, and here ascending mortals gather to hear the story of the long journey through Havona to Paradise.
p043.s4.b1: Lucifer coveted this mount. He purposed to exalt his throne above the Sons of God and to sit upon the mount of assembly in the north. Even after the rebellion the archrebels kept coming to the Edentia councils, until Michael assumed unlimited sovereignty; since then they have not been permitted to sit there. Shortly before Michael’s death in the flesh, Satan sought to attend again and was unanimously rejected.
p043.s4.b3: This sentence is worth reading at the level of a community. Evil seldom forces its way in; it enters where a door of sympathy has been left open. When the sentiment of a whole community stands firmly with the truth, agitation for evil finds no standing ground.
p043.s5.h: V. The Edentia Fathers since the Lucifer Rebellion
p043.s5.b0: The rotation of the Most Highs stopped at the time of the rebellion, and the present government has been expanded to twelve Vorondadek Sons. The current Constellation Father is number 617,318 of the Vorondadek series of Nebadon. Every isolated world has a Vorondadek observer, and one has been stationed on Urantia ever since the Caligastia betrayal; Machiventa Melchizedek paid respectful homage to him.

p043.s6.h: VI–VII. The Gardens of God; The Univitatia
p043.s6.b0: System capitals are adorned with material constructions and the universe headquarters reflects spiritual glory, but the constellation capitals are the acme of living embellishment. About half of Edentia is given to the gardens of the Most Highs, which is why such worlds are called “⟦Q 43:6.1⟧the gardens of God⟦/Q⟧,” and why beautiful places on the worlds of Norlatiadek are so often called “⟦Q 43:6.2⟧the garden of Eden.⟦/Q⟧” At the shrine in the center of the garden, the Most Highs lead all Edentia every tenth day in the worshipful contemplation of God the Supreme.
p043.s6.b2: Material life there falls into ten divisions: the first three we would call vegetable and the last three animal, but the middle four are beyond our imagining. There are no carnivorous creatures, and the animals are gentle and intelligent. Celestial artisans express their ideals not in paint and marble but in living materials.
p043.s6.b5: The permanent citizens of the constellation, the **univitatia**, are children of the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit. They live on a plane between the material and the spiritual, yet they are not morontia creatures. Spiritually they are alike, intellectually they vary, and they function in seventy orders of personality. In artistic skill and social adaptability, almost no being outside Havona can equal them.

p043.s7.b0: The time spent on the seventy training worlds is the most settled period of the whole ascending career. You are re-keyed each time you move to a new world, but you keep the same morontia body and never lose consciousness. The task of this period is **group ethics**: the secret of pleasant and profitable relationships among very different personalities.

p044.s0.h: Introduction — Is There Art in the Spirit World?
p044.s0.b0: Paper 44, indited by an Archangel of Nebadon, is about the **celestial artisans**, the master artists and craftsmen of the morontia and lower spirit realms. They are found on headquarters worlds throughout the grand universe, but their chief realm of activity is the constellations, especially the seven hundred seventy worlds surrounding each headquarters sphere.
p044.s0.b2: Celestial artisans are not created as such. They are a corps that began with seven thousand Havona instructors assigned by the Infinite Spirit in collaboration with the Seven Master Spirits, joined by volunteer pupils from among ascending mortals and many celestial groups. Any morontia personality or spirit below the rank of inherent divine sonship may join, but no one may enlist for less than a millennium.

p044.s1.h: The Question of Reality — What Is Real, and to Whom?
p044.s1.b0: Before the main subject, the Archangel lays down an important premise. The activities of the morontia and spirit worlds are real. For spirit beings, in fact, the material world is the more unreal, a mere shadow. He admits that he cannot, with spirit vision alone, perceive the very building in which this narrative is being translated and recorded; he discerns it through a spirit counterpart presented by an energy transformer.
p044.s1.b2: A warm promise follows. On the path of ascent we will never lose the power to recognize our associates of former stages. Each new translation or resurrection adds new beings to our vision without in the least depriving us of the ability to recognize old friends. This is possible because the Adjusters retain duplicates of our entire life experience.
p044.s1.b4: The Archangel is candid about his limits as well. To convey the meaning of these semispirit activities he must constantly pervert thought and distort language, and he presses on knowing he cannot be very successful. All he hopes is to make emphatic the fact that these things are real. The lists in this paper should therefore be read as a “crude parallelism” rather than precise description.

p044.s4.b0: The thought recorders preserve the superior thought of the realms in the tongue of Uversa. p044.s5.h: V–VII. The Energy Manipulators; The Designers and Embellishers; The Harmony Workers
p044.s5.b0: The energy manipulators handle physical, mindal, and spiritual energy. Spiritual energy acts according to established laws just as physical energy does. p044.s5.b2: Rest is not idleness. Just as pilgrims who have traversed the circles of Havona enter the long and revivifying rest of Paradise, rest is a necessary technique for replenishing spent energy and storing reserves of spirit power for the next stage.
p044.s5.b3: The designers and embellishers work in over a thousand subdivisions: craftworkers of color, sound designers, emotion designers, artists of odor, presence embellishers, taste designers, and morontia synthesizers. p044.s5.b6: Whether in art, science, or philosophy, the real soul of expression is absent unless the realities of truth, the meanings of beauty, and the values of goodness are unified in the life of the one expressing them. These three qualities are perfectly unified in God, and every God-knowing man or angel has the potential of unlimited self-expression by blending them in experience.
p044.s6.h: VIII. Mortal Aspirations and Morontia Achievements
p044.s6.b0: Celestial artisans sometimes come down from the system headquarters to help gifted mortals, working together with the seraphim. The Archangel names three sources of special human ability.

p044.s6.b3: The paper closes with deep comfort. There is no caste among spirit artisans; however lowly your origin, if you have ability you will receive due recognition. The handicaps of heredity and the deprivations of environment are made up in the morontia career. If something you longed to do on earth, but circumstances denied you, is still your desire after you gain true mota insight, you will be given every opportunity to fulfill it.
p044.s6.b5: This does not mean that everyone becomes the same. It is an equality of satisfaction; individuality of skill and expression is not erased, and selfish ambitions learn to become socialized.
p044.s7.b0: Paper 44 shows that the path of ascent is no dry discipline but a journey of culture, full of music and color, story and architecture, play and rest. It also tells us that the roots of this beauty are one with truth and goodness, and that unfulfilled dreams are not thrown away. The small art and care we offer now become first studies for that larger culture.
